bounceReasons.label: Recipient address rejected: user unknown
bounceReasons.pattern: User unknown in virtual mailbox table
bounceReasons.definition: The receiving mail server says the address does not exist.

bounceReasons.label: Message blocked by policy
bounceReasons.definition: The receiving mail server refused the message under a policy of its own.

participantFailures.label: Already in the participant list
participantFailures.pattern: Participant already exists in participant list
participantFailures.definition: The participant is already in the program, so the source did not add them again.

participantFailures.label: Unique criteria already met
participantFailures.pattern: Participant with unique criteria already exists
participantFailures.definition: A participant with the same unique criteria is already in the program.

participantFailures.label: Met the advanced criteria
participantFailures.pattern: Participant has met the advanced criteria
participantFailures.definition: The program's advanced criteria excluded the participant, as configured.

participantFailures.label: Unsubscribed from a category
participantFailures.pattern: Participant has unsubscribed from one or more categories
participantFailures.definition: The recipient has unsubscribed from an email category the program sends.

participantFailures.label: On the global opt-out
participantFailures.pattern: Participant part of Global Opt Out
participantFailures.definition: The recipient is on the tenant's global opt-out list.

participantFailures.label: On the bounce list
participantFailures.definition: The recipient's address is on the tenant's bounce list: it bounced before.

participantFailures.label: Opted out at the send step
participantFailures.definition: The recipient was on the global opt-out when the Send Email step ran.

participantFailures.label: Bounced at the send step
participantFailures.definition: The recipient's address had bounced when the Send Email step ran.

participantFailures.label: Invalid or missing value in a mapped field
participantFailures.definition: A field the program maps (most often the recipient's email address) holds no value or an invalid one on the participant record: a data problem at the source. The wording names the field.
